profile.name: Jaryl Ong
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and solution architect, mostly tinkering with Go, TypeScript, and AWS. I enjoy building clean APIs, simple backends, and cloud setups that quietly do their job. Away from the keyboard, there's usually Gunpla, Jiu-Jitsu, and some new way to stay fit.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Co-built a reusable dynamic form module on SurveyJS. Other teams ship form-heavy apps without writing the frontend from scratch.
Set up containerised CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker across core platform modules. Releases ship unattended.
Building an AI coding agent on Claude that scaffolds new repositories with our design principles, coding standards, and platform tooling wired in. Still a prototype, not in use yet.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed a full-stack dashboard framework in Go and Svelte. Internal teams build charts and UI widgets on one consistent foundation.

projects.name: Vault of Cards
projects.description: A marketplace for trading card collectors. Listings to browse and search, photo uploads, verified email sign-in, and real-time messaging between buyers and sellers. Next.js on the front, NestJS microservices on AWS behind it.
bullets: Built the Next.js frontend, with GitHub Actions deploying every push. No downtime, no manual steps.
Set up the AWS infrastructure on containerised microservices. Fast and available through traffic spikes.

projects.name: Askbot
projects.description: A study of what frameworks like LangChain do under the hood. Their core pieces rebuilt directly on the OpenAI SDK: token streaming, conversation memory, prompt construction. FastAPI on the backend, Next.js on the front.
